title: docs(extraction): finish #82's cleanup -- module B's own stale Jira references
body:
## What

#82 (closed 2026-09-15) decided to drop Jira from the product entirely -- both its credential paths (API token, OAuth 3LO) tie a workspace to whoever set it up, with no fix available within this project's scope. Its closing comment listed exactly what still assumed Jira and split the cleanup by ownership; the module-B-owned half ("B 승인 하나면 됨") was never actually done.

This session opened a PR building a brand new Jira sync (#331) without noticing #82 first -- closed unmerged once caught. That's what surfaced the older cleanup was still pending too, so this PR does both: finishes #82's original list and leaves nothing new behind.

## What changed

Comments and types only, no behavior change:
- `tasks.py`'s step 7 note, `service.py`'s `ext_external_refs` and `outbound_for_meeting` docstrings
- `pipeline/classifier.py`'s `_classifier_client` docstring (dropped `JiraClient` from the list of same-shaped example classes)
- `schemas.py`: `ExternalRefRead.system` narrowed from `Literal["notion", "jira"]` to `Literal["notion"]`, plus the `ActionItemRead.sync_refs`, `ReviewDecision.sync_refs` and `Outbound` docstrings
- `apps/web/src/features/actions/{types,api}.ts`: the matching `ExternalRefRead.system` type, the two `sync_refs` docstrings, and the `syncResults` comment
- `modules/extraction/CLAUDE.md`'s "What this module does" and privacy sections

## Not touched

`packages/core`'s `team_integrations` check constraint and `packages/contracts`' `ExternalSystem.JIRA` -- #82's own comment already scoped those as needing every module owner's approval and, for the frozen contracts package, a real decision about whether removing a value there counts as invariant 5's breaking change. Left for whoever picks that up next; not something to decide inside a module-B PR.

Also not touched: `ext_external_refs`/`ext_decision_refs`'s own DB check constraints (module B's, `models.py`) still allow `'jira'`. Nothing writes it anymore, so it's harmless dead capability rather than something worth a migration for.

## Tests

```
uv run pytest modules/extraction/tests/unit -q   # 505 passed, 1 skipped
uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
uv run mypy modules/extraction/src/autune_extraction
uv run lint-imports
```

`apps/web` edits are type-only (a union narrowed to a single literal, which only makes the type stricter) and comment rewrapping. `pnpm` was not available in this environment to run `eslint`/`tsc` -- noting that rather than skipping it silently.

## Scope

`modules/extraction/` (module B, including its own frontend path `apps/web/src/features/actions/`) only. No shared paths.
